purpose: Represent promotion completion as immutable evidence only after Layer 59 independently proves canonical source truth for the exact current binding.
hostedCadence: every 5 minutes, staggered after projection and incident reconciliation

states.closed: A current integrity-verified closure receipt matches the exact Layer-59 fingerprint and immutable binding.
states.open: Layer 59 passes but no closure receipt exists for the current binding/fingerprint.
states.stale: A receipt exists for the binding but the current canonical source-truth fingerprint or identity fields have changed.
states.invalid: The stored closure receipt fails its own SHA-256 integrity check.
states.blocked: Layer 59 itself does not pass or no canonical binding can be identified.

invariants: Binding creation is not promotion closure.
Projection repair is not promotion closure.
A closure receipt can be recorded only when Layer 59 is PASS.
The receipt binds to one exact binding ID, release ref, layer, source commit, runtime version, artifact and Layer-59 fingerprint.
Changed canonical source truth automatically makes an older receipt stale.
Closure recording is append-only evidence and never mutates authoritative release truth.
Runtime readiness is not claimed by a source-truth closure receipt.
Foundation runtime may read closure status but only service_role may record or assert closure.
Service role has no direct INSERT privilege on the closure ledger.
